item.title: MATERNAL SEPSIS: BREAKING THE SILENCE ON THE HIDDEN KILLER
item.description: 17th March 2026, Kampala – In a decisive move to confront one of the gravest threats to maternal and newborn health, the Ministry of Health has released critical findings from a landmark scientific study addressing infections during pregnancy and childbirth. The study reveals that simple, cost-effective interventions in health facilities can reduce severe maternal infections by 32 percent, a life-saving margin that demands immediate attention and national implementation. item.title: Government and Partners Launch Mass Malnutrition Screening Campaign in Refugee – Hosting Districts Amid Rising Cases
item.description: 19th March 2026, Kiryandongo – The Ministry of Health has launched a nationwide mass malnutrition screening campaign in partnership with UNICEF, UNHCR, WFP and WHO, targeting refugee-hosting communities across Uganda where malnutrition rates have risen sharply. The campaign comes as recent data shows a reversal of earlier gains.
